mirrorOrOtherProjectWarning: No mirror and no other project shown. FRAME WARNING: the entrance door is NOT on the street/garage-door gable. It is in the long side wall that faces the left of the plan sheet, inside the corner between the main body and the garage. Following the rule 'FRONT = facade with the main entrance door', FRONT here is that long side (the 16.6 m side). Consequently the street gable with the garage door is RIGHT, the garden gable with the roofed terrace is LEFT, and the long almost blank side is REAR. The designer's own 'front elevation' / site-plan entry arrow and the published 'building width 11.55 m' refer to the street gable, i.e. to this frame's RIGHT facade and DEPTH.

mainRoof.notes: Steep gable roof, ridge parallel to the entrance side; open decorative white timber trusses in both gable peaks. One gabled cross-dormer with balcony on the front slope. Lower gable roof of the garage continues the same ridge direction at the right end, offset to the rear, with its own gable (triangular glazing) facing the street. Lean-to roof over the terrace across the left gable. The upper floor of the main gable overhangs the entrance porch at the front-right corner, carried by one dark pillar.

FRONT storey 0, left to right: dining glazing, narrow tall window in the wood-clad kitchen bay, entrance door with sidelight (one opening), garage ribbon window. The ribbon window is classed LARGE_GLAZING only by the width rule; it is a low high-level strip.
FRONT storey 1: the balcony door sits in a wall dormer whose face is in the facade plane; it is counted as a storey-1 GLAZED_DOOR and also listed as a DORMER feature.
RIGHT (street gable) storey 0 window is the single fixed kitchen pane, about 2.5 m wide - on the WINDOW / LARGE_GLAZING boundary; counted as WINDOW.
RIGHT storey 1: bathroom window in the main gable (with a dark panel beside it) and the triangular glazing of the garage gable.
REAR: single small glass-block window (boiler room); the two small rectangles on the roof plan are the chimneys, no rooflights are shown.
Balcony/dormer centre is at about 0.35 of the front length - on the LEFT/CENTRE boundary.
